questions.question_text: With reference to the Constitution of India, which one of the following rights is guaranteed under Article 21?
questions.explanation: Article 21 guarantees Protection of Life and Personal Liberty. The Supreme Court in the historic Justice K.S. Puttaswamy (Retd.) v. Union of India (2017) judgment unanimously held that the Right to Privacy is an intrinsic part of the right to life and personal liberty under Article 21.

options.option_text: Right to strike against unfair workplace policies
Right to Privacy as an intrinsic component of liberty
Right to property as a fundamental right
Right to claim unrestricted government employment

questions.question_text:
Consider the following statements regarding the Attorney General for India:
1. He has the right of audience in all courts in India.
2. He has the right to speak and take part in the proceedings of either House of Parliament.
3. He has the right to vote in parliamentary joint sessions.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Under Article 76 and Article 88 of the Indian Constitution, the Attorney General has the right of audience in all courts in India and can take part in parliamentary proceedings, but has NO right to vote.

questions.question_text: Which one of the following schedules of the Constitution of India contains provisions regarding anti-defection law?
questions.explanation: The 10th Schedule was added by the 52nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1985, and deals with disqualification on grounds of defection.

questions.question_text: In the Indian parliamentary model, a Money Bill can be introduced only in:
questions.explanation: Under Article 109 of the Constitution of India, a Money Bill shall not be introduced in the Council of States (Rajya Sabha). It can only be introduced in the Lok Sabha with the prior recommendation of the President.

options.option_text: The Lok Sabha with the prior recommendation of the President
Either House of Parliament without any prior recommendation
The Rajya Sabha directly by the Finance Minister
A joint committee of both Houses

questions.question_text: Which writ is issued by the higher courts to command an inferior court or tribunal to perform its legal duty?
questions.explanation: Mandamus literally means "We Command". It is an order from a superior court to any government, court, corporation or public authority to do a specific act which that body is obliged under law to do.

questions.question_text: A shopkeeper sells an article at a discount of 15% on the marked price and still makes a profit of 19%. If the marked price of the article is Rs. 1400, find its cost price.
questions.explanation: Selling Price (SP) = 1400 * (1 - 0.15) = 1400 * 0.85 = Rs. 1190. Since profit is 19%, SP = CP * 1.19. Therefore CP = 1190 / 1.19 = Rs. 1000.

questions.question_text: Two trains of lengths 140 m and 160 m run on parallel tracks. When running in the same direction, the faster train passes the slower one in 30 seconds. When running in opposite directions, they pass each other in 6 seconds. What is the speed of the faster train (in km/h)?
questions.explanation: Total distance = 140 + 160 = 300 m. Relative speed in same direction = (v1 - v2) = 300 / 30 = 10 m/s. Relative speed in opposite direction = (v1 + v2) = 300 / 6 = 50 m/s. Adding the equations: 2 * v1 = 60 => v1 = 30 m/s. In km/h: 30 * (18/5) = 108 km/h.

questions.question_text: If x + (1/x) = 3, what is the value of x^3 + (1/x^3)?
What is the worst-case time complexity of inserting n keys into an empty AVL tree?
questions.explanation: An AVL tree is a self-balancing binary search tree. Each insertion takes O(log k) where k is the current number of keys. Inserting n elements sequentially takes sum of O(log i) for i=1 to n, which evaluates to O(n log n). Because the tree remains strictly height-balanced, worst-case height is always O(log n).

questions.question_text: Which of the following problems can be solved in polynomial time by reducing to a maximum bipartite matching problem?
questions.explanation: By Konig theorem, in any bipartite graph, the maximum matching size equals the minimum vertex cover size. Thus minimum vertex cover on bipartite graphs is solvable in polynomial time.

options.option_text: Minimum Vertex Cover on Bipartite Graphs

questions.question_text: In relational database theory, if every non-prime attribute is fully functionally dependent on the primary key, the relation is in at least:
questions.explanation: A relation is in Second Normal Form (2NF) if it is in 1NF and no non-prime attribute is partially dependent on any candidate key (i.e. every non-prime attribute is fully functionally dependent on every candidate key).

questions.question_text: India recently launched the NISAR (NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar) earth observation mission. Which frequency bands does NISAR utilize to track changes in Earth ecosystems and ice masses?
questions.explanation: NISAR is the world first dual-frequency radar imaging earth observation satellite. It operates in both L-band (developed by NASA JPL) and S-band (developed by ISRO) radar frequencies to provide systematic high-resolution planetary scanning.

questions.question_text: Which Indian state recently launched the "Mission Vatsalya Digital Registry" to enhance the monitoring and welfare delivery of vulnerable children?
questions.explanation: Mission Vatsalya is a centrally sponsored child protection services scheme under the Ministry of Women and Child Development, implemented across states with real-time digital registries to ensure rehabilitation and foster care monitoring.

questions.question_text: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for the establishment of the Finance Commission to recommend the distribution of tax revenues between the Union and the States?
questions.explanation: Article 280 of the Constitution provides for the constitution of a Finance Commission by the President of India every fifth year (or at such earlier time as the President considers necessary).

questions.question_text: Which of the following constitutional amendments incorporated the 'Right to Education' as a Fundamental Right under Article 21A?
questions.explanation: The 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002, inserted Article 21A into the Constitution of India to make free and compulsory education for children between the ages of 6 and 14 a Fundamental Right.

questions.question_text: With reference to the Indian economy, which of the following is the primary monetary policy tool used by the RBI to absorb surplus liquidity on an overnight basis without collateral?
questions.explanation: The Standing Deposit Facility (SDF), operationalized by the RBI in 2022 under amended Section 17 of the RBI Act, enables the central bank to absorb surplus liquidity without requiring government securities as collateral.

questions.question_text: A sum of money at compound interest doubles itself in 4 years. In how many years will it amount to 8 times itself at the same rate?
questions.explanation: If P becomes 2P in 4 years, then it becomes 2^3 P = 8P in 4 * 3 = 12 years.

questions.question_text: In modern operating systems, which scheduling algorithm is provably optimal in minimizing the average waiting time for a given set of processes?
questions.explanation: Shortest Job First (SJF) scheduling is provably optimal because moving a short process before a long one decreases the waiting time of the short process more than it increases that of the long process.
